Subject: Fenwick Health — Implementation preview & topology questions

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the discovery yesterday — felt very productive. We'd like to schedule a technical session to walk through the target deployment topology and the parts that will affect our security and latency SLAs (networking, KMS, VPC peering, and cold-start expectations). Our engineering lead (Samir) will join.

High-level asks:
- Can you run through how Redwood handles private VPC + customer-managed KMS?
- Expected p95 tail latency for 1–3k qps for short prompts and for longer contextual requests (up to 4k tokens).
- Any recommended quantization/instance profiles for cost vs. latency tradeoffs for our use case.
- Per-route rollout options and how fallbacks are configured across model variants.

We are flexible on timing but would prefer the week of 11/16. Proposed window: 11/17 in the afternoon (ET) or 11/18 morning (ET). 60–75 minutes should be enough.

I've attached the post-discovery notes and our firewall rules spreadsheet for reference.

Thanks,
Lena

Hi Lena — great to hear. 11/17 or 11/18 both work for us. To ensure the session is actionable, I'll bring Ben from Solutions Engineering to cover runtime topologies and Irene to cover deployment/ops constraints.

Suggested agenda (60 min):
1) 5m - Intros & desired outcomes
2) 15m - Proposed topology walk (VPC/KMS, egress controls)
3) 20m - Runtime behavior & latency expectations with sample traffic profiles
4) 15m - Deployment controls (rollouts, fallbacks, model variants) + next steps
5) 5m - Q&A / action items

Can you confirm which of these three times on 11/17 ET works for you: 14:00, 15:30, 16:30? We'll send a calendar invite after you confirm. I've attached a short agenda preview.

Also, could Samir share a brief note on what their test traffic looks like (qps, average prompt length, percent embeddings calls), that helps us prepare a quick latency simulation.

Thanks,
Aditya

Morning all — happy to lead the runtime portion. A couple of quick asks so the session is high signal:
- If you can drop a sanitized sample trace or a small CSV with qps by endpoint and token distributions that will let me run a quick back-of-the-envelope batch sizing.
- We'll want to review the network diagram (ingress/egress, NAT/Gateway, peering) live; can you share an editable diagram or the existing PNG?

I'll prepare:
- P95/P99 historical numbers across model sizes for similar workloads
- Recommended instance/quantization profiles and expected unit costs at baseline and at 2x traffic

Irene, I'll sync with you about what to show for rollout policies and can add the canary examples.

Cheers,
Ben
